dialogue: The desks have been pushed to the walls. The principal's office is now the presiding officer's room. There is a sign on the door listing what you cannot bring inside. The queue extends down the front steps and around the corner.
An elderly woman in front of you looks confused. She is holding a piece of paper and looking between two different queue lines.

options.text: Help the elderly woman find her name on the register.
options.consequence: You help her. She has voted in every election since 1971. She finds her name. You step up to the desk.

options.text: You are in a rush. Move past her.
options.consequence: You move ahead. You step up to the desk.
